name: v7-shape
description:
REGRESSION LOCK for two defects found against a real snipe/snipe-it:v7.0.13 container.

(a) The foreign id was `str(asset['id'])` -- the bare per-instance auto-increment primary key. Every Snipe-IT install numbers its register from 1, so two instances imported into one runZero account collide on 1, 2, 3 and overwrite each other's assets. The id is now scoped on the hostname of the configured URL, and the namespaced_ids invariant enforces it here rather than being skipped as it was in every snipe-it scenario before.

(b) build_assets read asset['networks'] and walked networks['v4'] / networks['v6']. The v7 API returns no such key, so that whole block was dead code and no address ever reached an interface from it. Hardware 32 is the proof: it carries a fully populated legacy `networks` block and NO address custom field, and must emit with no ipAddresses at all. A run that still reads the key would import 203.0.113.32 and fail this assertion. Addresses now come from where Snipe-IT actually keeps them, a custom field on the model's fieldset -- the same place the MAC this script already reads comes from. Hardware 31 matches on field_format (the operator named the field 'Mgmt IP', which no name list would guess), and hardware 33 matches on the conventional field name with no field_format, which is what a field created with the free-form ANY format looks like.
